payload.evidence_against: The HMM branches remain catastrophe-prone and regress the observable edge panel. T038's destructive controls targeted the selected HMM configuration rather than the ultimately winning PF branch, so PF-specific evidence-destruction controls remain mandatory in E013. The 20-well primary panel is a worth screen, not full promotion evidence.
payload.evidence_for: T038 completed all 24 fixed candidates and seven registered controls. The fixed 75% likelihood-PF plus 25% E011 candidate reaches 6.1144320131 RMSE versus E011 at 12.9126155867 on the score-blind fold-stratified panel, wins 5/5 fold strata, lowers p90 from 18.4192 to 9.7080, lowers worst-20% SSE share from 0.5482 to 0.4780, and improves the observable edge panel by 1.1533 RMSE. Independent rerun reproduces every decisive metric and artifact identity exactly.
payload.next_test: Execute H031/T039/E013: a clean-room full-773 implementation of the frozen sequential likelihood-PF and fixed 0.75 placement, with PF-specific no-emission, reversed-typewell, shifted-GR, permuted-GR, seed-order, missing-data, deterministic, group, tail, and runtime controls.
payload.statement: Independent public trajectory mechanisms, especially exact second-order HMM smoothing and likelihood-weighted PF, contain enough complementary legal whole-tail shape signal to justify a clean-room full-data experiment with E011.
payload.title: Public trajectory mechanisms add complementary legal shape signal
